title: Book One · Chapter 85: Two Games at Break
story:
Leo is already playing when Ronan comes into the yard.

He is with the boys from his new boat group. They have a little cloth ball. One boy throws it high. Leo catches it against his chest.

Ronan walks over. He brought the flat stone for their usual game.

“Are you coming?” he asks.

“After this.”

“How long?”

“Until we miss three catches.”

The boy throws again. Leo catches again. Ronan stands beside the wall with the stone in his warm hand.

Mei comes out with a book. She sits on a low step in the shade.

“Why are you waiting?” she asks.

“For Leo.”

“Do you want to play that game?”

“He did not ask.”

“Have you asked?”

Ronan has not. He watches another catch. He wants Leo to ask him to play. He does not want to ask first.

Mei opens her book. It is not a boat book. There are birds on the page. She saw a bird near the classroom window. Now she is looking for that bird in her book.

Ronan sits beside her.

“That has very long legs.”

“So did the bird.”

“Could it carry a stone?”

She turns to look at him. Then they both laugh. Ronan is asking about stones again, just like at school. But Mei is looking at birds, not making boats.

Leo misses a catch. The cloth ball rolls towards the step. Ronan picks it up.

“May I have a turn?”

One of the other boys nods. “Stand there. Not too close.”

Ronan puts his stone on the step beside Mei. He joins the game. His first catch bounces off both hands. He runs after it and throws it back too hard. The boy ducks.

“Lower,” Leo says.

Ronan tries lower. The next throw reaches the boy's hands. After three more misses, they change places.

He does not become the best player. He does catch two in a row. When the bell rings, he wants another turn.

Leo touches his arm. “Your stone.”

Ronan runs to the step. Mei put it on his book. Now he will see it and remember to take it.

“Thank you.”

“I did not want to carry your stone inside.”

During the next lesson, Miss Wu asks for someone to bring the reading cards. Leo begins to get up, but she chooses Ronan. The cards are not heavy. But he needs to keep the cards in order. That part is harder.

He gives one pile to each row. At the back, a child invites him to another game. They will play tomorrow. “I can try it after lunch,” Ronan says. He cannot play there if the yard is wet.

He looks towards Leo. His friend is writing with his tongue just outside his mouth. He did not hear the other child's invitation.

At the end of school, the boys walk together as far as the first corner. Leo tells him the long boat has finally stayed up.

“Can I see tomorrow?”

“Yes. Can I try your flat stone game after?”

Ronan nods. He wanted this all morning. Now he needs to fit in another game too.

He walks home with the stone in one pocket. The folded reading card is in the other. Leo played with other boys today. He still wants to play with Ronan tomorrow. Ronan thinks of the flat stone game and smiles.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- catch＝接住
- in a row＝连续
- invitation＝邀请
- fit in＝安排进去

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：chest＝胸前；shade＝阴凉处；bounce＝弹起。

## 读句提示

**He still wants to play with Ronan tomorrow.**

他仍想／明天和Ronan玩。He指Leo，want to与首章同类。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan最初为什么没有加入接球游戏？
2. 他发现朋友可以怎样安排不同的活动？
